formula: Delete a baseline entity iff the identical (pmc_id, offset, length, text) held mention has a complete EOS, uncapped, strictly parsed NO output. Retain HPO/NIL/rejected/missing; keep all other entity objects in original order and all nonentity objects. No replacements/additions.
zero_change: inherit exact baseline bytes and metrics, zero v2
gate: strict Score > baseline; no originaldev/full64 without secondfold validation
prior_mechanism: 9B binary entity-slot veto was already negative. This reuses a different completed Qwen3 head explicitly trained with 578 additional annotation-negative spans; does not claim first-ever entity veto.
